data.answer: The company laptop is returned, and the device is wiped within 3 business days of the person's exit time.
All access is revoked within 4 hours of the person's exit time.
Yes, a web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.
When a bank forwards a request from an individual for access, correction, or erasure, Nimbus Labs responds to the bank within 15 days.
Riya Sharma is the named privacy lead.
Nimbus Labs designs Nimbus Ledger Sync for alignment with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, but this is a design goal and not a certification or compliance statement.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Administrator accounts must use hardware security keys in addition to passwords, and shared accounts are not permitted.
The incident response plan is exercised through a tabletop drill twice a year, and the latest drill took place on 4 June 2026.
A customer administrator can request early deletion in writing, and Nimbus Labs confirms completion by email within 10 business days of the request.
